human_semantic_audit.structural_root_cause: Composite semantic landmark containing a modifier/subfeature may currently be promoted using only parent whole-entity FMA geometry, while the extracted child subfeature is not required to participate in the executable dependency chain.
required_contracts: A composite operand containing border/superior border/inferior border/midpoint/anterior border/posterior border/end/apex or equivalent subfeature cannot be RESOLVED solely by the parent whole-entity mesh.
If a relation uses a composite landmark with an extracted child subfeature, the executable dependency chain must bind and use that child subfeature or remain UNRESOLVED.
Pose/body-position conditions incompatible with default atlas pose must remain CONDITIONAL.

new_defect_families.detail: Distance/value/unit/calibration semantics present in WHO/B must remain attached to repaired relation/dependency semantics and human-review projection.
Resolved midpoint/center/midpoint-between outputs must be represented as derived geometry identities and consumed by downstream relations when a named derived semantic operand exists.
An ontology/FMA-resolved lexicalized anatomical entity such as spinous process must not be re-decomposed into parent vertebra + generic process child for execution.
Recognized lexical synonyms such as free extremity must normalize to a canonical subfeature type (free_end); unresolved geometry is distinct from unknown semantic type.

human_semantic_audit.pass_scope: Vertical Slice v1 20-point Stage 2 semantic execution only
resolved_defect_families: lexicalized anatomical entity false subfeature split

non_blocking_watchpoints.description: Suppressed/provenance-only parse nodes may remain in the audit graph, but they must never participate in canonical semantic execution, point-status determination, or false RESOLVED inference.

provenance_policy.condition_for_non_blocking: The residue/edge must not participate in canonical execution, point-level status aggregation, or false RESOLVED inference.

defect_family_promotion_criteria: A. WHO/source semantics is actually lost or transformed.
C. The issue can produce false RESOLVED or an incorrect coordinate.
D. The same structural failure repeats across independent source expressions.
E. A frozen semantic-contract invariant is violated.
point_specific_overfitting_forbidden: point-specific suppression added only to pass a validator
individual point patch accepted as a defect-family fix
